steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Fit. Heads, ramp time and productivity are combined to cover the target.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: capacity does not cover the target

findings.title: Capacity does not cover the target

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] productivity.csv:12  Capacity does not cover the target.
       Fix: Add heads or raise productivity.
[medium] ramp-time.md:19  Ramp time missing.
       Fix: Record the ramp time.
[low] target.md:26  Productivity figure with no source.
       Fix: Name the source.
Not checked: Attrition beyond the assumptions.
pros: Checks a productivity figure with no source, a ramp time missing, and a capacity that does not cover the target.
cons: Not checked: Attrition beyond the assumptions.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-sales-capacity-plan skill on the records for this review.
